text:
Ellsworth among 54 cities tied for 29th in Kansas for June scam reports
Ellsworth was one of 54 cities tied for 29th among 82 Kansas cities with at least one BBB Scam Tracker report in June 2026, recording one scam report, according to Better Business Bureau.
There were no scam reports listed for the city in the previous month.
The report listed a $59.95 loss related to an investment scam. The reporter said the experience was nearly identical to other Scam Tracker entries.
BBB Scam Tracker lets consumers search reported scams and share their experiences to help others spot similar schemes. The BBB says it reviews each report before publication and does not publicly display the reporter’s name or personal contact information.
Fraud reports have continued to show large financial losses nationwide. The Federal Trade Commission said consumers reported losing more than $12.5 billion to fraud in 2024, a 25% increase from the previous year.
